## Hey there! 👋  I'm Kyle Grealis...

I'm a biostatistician and open source software developer at the University of Miami. Before that, I spent about 20 years as a respiratory therapist and served in the Army. The clinical tools aren't accidental.

I build software for biostatistics, clinical research, and reproducible data workflows. My stack centers on R, Quarto, and TypeScript, backed by pure declarative NixOS across my personal fleet and Cloudflare at the edge. I'm particularly interested in pragmatic DevOps and agentic pair-programming workflows.

I don't have a hot take on your favorite package. I just build things and put them here.

### Featured Projects

* **[sumExtras](r-packages/index.qmd):** Resilient, boilerplate-free clinical summary tables for `gtsummary`.
* **[nhanesdata](r-packages/index.qmd):** Cloud-hosted, survey-weighted access to CDC NHANES data (1999–2023).
* **[froggeR](r-packages/index.qmd):** Scaffolding and research compendium templates for reproducible R & Quarto projects.

### Active Focus

* **Clinical Biostatistics:** Longitudinal modeling, survival analysis, and clinical research tools at UM.
* **Declarative Systems:** Multi-node fleet management and reproducible environments with NixOS.
* **Modern Tooling:** Autonomous agentic workflows, TypeScript, and edge deployments.

:::
